patterns.note: Utilizes full-bleed background imagery and video to create immersive sections, often with content centered or in a wide-column layout.
Employs extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for primary headings, creating a powerful and direct visual statement.
High-contrast palette dominated by a vibrant, aggressive red, black, and white, with warm orange accents for visual interest and character details.

The hero section features a large, fixed text overlay ('PROPER PROMPTS') that remains in place while a background video (featuring a playful dragon) scrolls underneath, creating a strong parallax effect. A persistent, sticky banner is anchored to the bottom of the viewport.
Features distinct, full-width sections that alternate between dark and light backgrounds, often incorporating large imagery or video to define their visual character.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a full-width background video that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax effect, with a large, fixed text element positioned over this video. Other sections likely use CSS keyframe animations to fade or slide elements into view as they enter the viewport. A persistent call-to-action banner is fixed to the bottom of the screen using sticky positioning.
Full-bleed background images and videos are used to establish mood and context for each section. Text is overlaid directly on these backgrounds, often with high contrast colors to ensure readability.
Headings are rendered in an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif font, often in a vibrant red, to command immediate attention. Body text uses a more standard, legible sans-serif for clarity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very aggressive, oversized, uppercase display headings (easily 5-6x body text size) paired with clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners, with very subtle rounding on buttons and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating clear visual breaks. Content within sections is more balanced.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely large, fixed, uppercase red typography in the hero, combined with a playful, character-driven video background that creates a strong parallax effect. This bold, almost aggressive visual language, softened by the whimsical dragon, makes it memorable.
